svg.text: EQUIPMENT ACCESS PAIR, INACTIVE LEAF FLUSH
WINDOW LOCATIONS (CENTERLINE FROM GRID 1 OR GRID A): S @ X 3'-0", N @ X 4'-6", N @ X 13'-6", W @ Y 5'-0"
ARROW = OPERABLE SASH, VIEWED FROM EXTERIOR
HARDWARE SETS (LEARNING, CONFIRM WITH HARDWARE SUPPLIER + AHJ)
SET 1 (101A PAIR): 3 HINGES PER LEAF (NON-REMOVABLE PINS, OUT-SWING), FLUSH BOLTS TOP + BOTTOM AT INACTIVE
LEAF, STOREROOM LOCKSET, OVERLAPPING ASTRAGAL, THRESHOLD PER 8/A501, WEATHERSTRIP, DOOR SWEEPS, WALL OR
SET 2 (101B): 3 HINGES (NON-REMOVABLE PINS), STOREROOM LOCKSET, SURFACE CLOSER, THRESHOLD PER 8/A501,
ACCESSIBILITY: IF THE BUILDING MUST BE ACCESSIBLE, VERIFY CLEAR WIDTH, MANEUVERING CLEARANCES, HARDWARE HEIGHT
AND THRESHOLD HEIGHT WITH THE ADOPTED ACCESSIBILITY STANDARD.
TAGS MATCH A101 PLAN, A201 ELEVATIONS AND A301 SECTIONS. ONE MODEL DRIVES ALL OF THEM.
ROUGH OPENINGS SHOWN ARE LEARNING VALUES. USE THE MANUFACTURER R.O. FOR THE SELECTED DOOR AND WINDOW.
FLASH EVERY OPENING SHINGLE-FASHION: SILL PAN FIRST, JAMB FLASHING, HEAD FLASHING, WRB HEAD FLAP LAST (5/A501).
HEADERS AND JACK / KING STUDS PER A601 FRAMING ELEVATIONS. VERIFY SIZES FOR ACTUAL LOADS.
VERIFY WITH A LICENSED PROFESSIONAL + THE AHJ
DRAWUP TYPICAL LEARNING CONTENT · NOT FOR CONSTRUCTION · EVERY VIEW ON EVERY SHEET IS CUT FROM ONE BUILDING MODEL, SO TAGS, DIMENSIONS + LEVELS AGREE ACROSS THE SET.
